# Steam — pre-existing corpses and spared-life statistics

- Original source: [Steam — pre-existing corpses and spared-life statistics](https://steamcommunity.com/app/46560/discussions/0/3071992488504267275/)
- Author / publication: Karczek 26⁵⁰ zł/kg and respondents / Steam Community
- Language / date: English; opened 2021-04-05; later replies show February and March without years
- Access: Opening and all six replies inspected through direct HTML retrieval
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

The opener reports 98% spared lives after rescuing Little John without killing anyone. After replaying the mission, they attribute the shortfall to bodies already present when it starts.

Respondents agree that pre-existing deaths affect the result; another also says kills by allied soldiers count against the player's statistics. The opener later reports finishing the campaign at 97%.

This is useful evidence for distinguishing player-caused deaths from the displayed statistic. The thread contains observations and recollections, not an engine trace. A later reply suggests editing initial conditions, which would alter the scenario and was not attempted here.
